# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best: it passed the frozen simulation and tool gates with 26 LUTs, 25 FFs, WNS 0.702 ns and WHS 0.069 ns. Timing is feasible, so iteration 2 must strictly reduce LUT use while preserving the fixed UART behavior and the required `// @latency 1` annotation.

## Hypothesis
Replacing variable-index data-bit selection with a shifting data register may reduce LUT use by removing the indexed mux while keeping the existing counter and registered outputs.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the current top interface, counters, reset behavior and timing schedule, but change `data_reg[bit_index]` serialization to output `data_reg[0]` and shift the captured byte right at each data-bit boundary. Capture `in_data` only on an accepted transfer, and ensure the shift schedule emits all eight bits least-significant bit first before the unchanged stop interval. Preserve `// @latency 1`, registered `tx` and `in_ready`, and busy-time input ignoring; the candidate must pass every fixed gate and strictly beat 26 routed LUTs.
